text:
Priya Rao: Quick check-in on Veridian renewal - customer asking to shorten to 9mo and wants proration on final invoice. Can CS/ops prepare amendment?
Marco Diaz: Do we have a PO? Procurement usually needs vendor code before Docusign.
Evelyn Chen: They sent PO-88219 but no vendor code. I can draft amendment once we confirm billing entity.
Samir Patel: Onboarding flagged billing-entity mismatch. Legal will need to confirm signatory authority for the shortened term. Tagging @LegalBot.
LegalBot: Policy note: Term reductions require an exec-signed amendment + updated SOW. Include billing-entity confirmation.
Priya Rao: Finance ok with proration example? Use: Annual $120k -> 9/12 = $90k; credit $30k applied to final invoice.
Marco Diaz: Procurement can grant an exception if Maya approves. I'll escalate. Net60 requested by customer  is that acceptable?
Maya (Procurement): Exception ok provisionally; vendor code must be posted within 3 business days or we cancel the exception.
Evelyn Chen: I'll prepare a one-page amendment + SOW patch with "9mo pro-rated subscription" line, Net60 term, and optional KMS appendix. ETA 3 hrs.
Priya Rao: Great. Once Docusign is sent and vendor code is in, I'll coordinate renewal date and deployment windows. Capture "budget timing shift" as reason in account health.
Marco Diaz: Vendor code should be live by tomorrow morning per Maya.
Evelyn Chen: Docusign envelope created and sent: https://docusign.example/envelope/5050101010
Samir Patel: I'll loop billing for rev-rec and note the enablement follow-up.
Priya Rao: Status: awaiting vendor code + signature. Will ping sales if any delay. :thumbsup:
